Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 i number(5);
 row_go number(5);
 rrec_cnt number(2);

BEGIN

 select count(*)
 into row_go
 from usable_reagents
 where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and qc_flag is not null
 and test_kit_id = :s_test_kit_id
 and chk_out_reason = 'QC'
 and reagent_type = 'C';

 go_record(1);

 FOR i in 1 .. row_go LOOP
 
 select count(*)
 into rrec_cnt
 from master_codes
 where code_type in ('CNTRL', 'NCTRL')
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 1)
 and code = :control_info.super_result;
 
 if rrec_cnt = 0 or :super_result is null then
 show_error('2330');
 :global.incomp := '1';
 go_item('super_result');
 exit;
 else
 :global.incomp := '0';
 :control_info.actual_result := :control_info.super_result;
 if :control_info.super_result = :control_info.control_ind then
 :global.dummy06 := 1;
 :control_info.qc_flag := 'Y';
 else
 :global.dummy06 := 3;
 :control_info.qc_flag := 'N';
 
 go_record(1);
 
 FOR i in 1 .. row_go LOOP
 if :control_info.super_result = :control_info.control_ind then
 
 :control_info.qc_flag := 'Y';
 else
 
 :control_info.qc_flag := 'N';
 end if;
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN -- IM 338
 NULL;
 ELSE
 down;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 exit;
 
 end if;
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN -- IM 338
 NULL;
 ELSE
 down;
 END IF;
 end if;
 
 END LOOP;

 if :global.incomp = '0' then
 
 execute_trigger('validate_reagents');
 commit;
 bell;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 else
 go_item('super_result');
 end if;
END;

end;
